additions.section: new: How the result is reported
additions.sentence: UK laboratories report an eGFR alongside every creatinine result, in line with NICE guidance.
additions.evidence: Page cites NICE NG203 as requiring UK laboratories to report an eGFR with every creatinine result

additions.section: new: What can affect the result
additions.sentence: People with more muscle naturally make more creatinine, which can give a lower eGFR than their kidney function really is.
additions.evidence: Muscle mass can skew results; people with more muscle produce more creatinine

additions.section: new: What can affect the result
additions.sentence: Cystatin C is another marker filtered by the kidneys and is less affected by muscle mass than creatinine.

additions.sentence: The NHS says a very low ACR usually means the kidneys are working normally, while a very high one points to more severe kidney disease.
